messages:
anya (eng): Postmortem is up. Short chain: simultaneous token refreshes + model-reg metadata spike -> vendor auth endpoint throttled -> our fallback flow amplified requests. Impact: ~8m elevated errors for hosted-api. doc: https://redwood.in/postmortems/1950001111
max (sre): Observed auth 429 burst at 03:14 UTC. KV cache cold caused parallel refreshes. Need single-flight refresh and stronger backoff on auth calls.
leo (vendor-relations): Opened ticket VEND-1147 with vendor. They want a 2-min trace and a sampling of request IDs. @anya can you attach?
anya (eng): Pasted tiny trace and safe curl snippet in the postmortem: ```for i in {1..100}; do curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://model-reg.internal/v1/meta & done``` Also adding single-flight token cache PR.
maria (security): Action: audit service principal rotation schedule, add jitter and enforce HSM logs for rotations. Owner: maria. ETA: 2026-04-07.
joanna (legal): I'll extract the rate-limit/SLA clause and give a test-notice template for the vendor dry-run. ETA: 2026-03-29.
prakash (product): We should label this incident class "external-auth-blast" and add to monthly recurrence review. Owner: prakash. ETA: 2026-03-31. Also prepare a short customer note if we schedule a dry-run.
max (sre): Short-term mitigation: circuit-breaker on auth endpoints + alert if auth 429/5xx > 2% sustained for 2m. Owner: max. ETA: 2026-03-24. I'll draft ops checklist for the dry-run.
slo-bot: Incident summary: duration 8m, peak auth failure 82%, hosted-api SLO delta 0.02%.
anya (eng): Long-term: spike dual-auth-path feasibility (backup internal token service) and add CI harness that'll simulate token rotation spikes. Owner: anya. ETA: 2026-05-12. Closing: updating postmortem with owners and tracker links.
